objective: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.

description: I will give you a weapon, <name>, but first you must aid me.  The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past.  They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me!  The cowards!
They took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars.  If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.
Search for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
progress: Do you have my steel bars?
completion: You found them! And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me. I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.
Thank you, <name>. Here is your reward. May it serve you well.
